listing.name: Hall of Triumph 2.0 (New Questline, Structure, System, Ships and More!)
listing.aiSummary: Adds a unique ship-storage structure that generates story points and unlocks trophy hullmods through a recruitable officer and a multi-stage story quest.

description:
Ship Gallery

Spoiler

[close]

Hall of Triumph 2.0

Turn all those rare, unique, and questionably acquired ships gathering dust in storage into a monument to your accomplishments—and make them generate story points while they are at it.

For Starsector 0.98a |

Source Code and Issue Tracker

Updating from 1.0.x? Delete the old Hall of Triumph folder before installing 2.0. Do not overwrite the previous installation.

What Does This Do?

Adds the Hall of Triumph, a unique ship-storage structure for your colonies. Ships placed on display remain stored normally while contributing to passive story-point generation across your entire Hall of Triumph network.

Adds Isa Leicester, a salvager, ship-modder, recruitable officer, and terrible influence overall. Display enough ships from different factions and doctrines to unlock unique 0-OP trophy hullmods through her showcase programs.

Version 2.0 also adds Isa's complete story quest, A Borrowed Name, leading through the Shattered Ring, both Coronal Hypershunts, experimental Mk IV fleets, and the sealed prototype Dyson sphere of Gan Eden.

What Is in This Mod?

New colony structure: Hall of TriumphNew NPC contact and officer: Isa LeicesterNew story quest: A Borrowed NameNew location: The Shattered Ring, an Independent free port in Penelope's StarNew hidden system: Gan Eden, a prototype Dyson sphere containing four colonizable settlement sitesVanilla trophy hullmods: Legacy, Zeal, Pageantry, Optimization, Humanity, Memory, Awe, Gaze, and ContemptCross-mod trophy hullmods: Honor, Resonance, Discipline, Inheritance, and VowExperimental Mk IV ships: Pirate and Luddic Path refit programs with custom variants and faction-specific artworkNew encounters: Hypershunt blockades, the Ivory Custodians, COMSEC REDACTED, and escalating rematchesAdditional content: Custom illustrations, combat environments, music, faction vignettes, Gan Eden Archives, and a unique D-mod service at the Shattered RingCross-mod content integration:
Black Lion ShipsKnights HospitallerUnited Aurora FederationKnights of LuddIron ShellCombat Chatter

But Why?

I was playing Starsector and realized I had all these cool unique ships, but because I was roleplaying a particular fleet flavor or whatever, I had no use for them. So I chucked them into storage and imagined it as a kind of trophy room.

Then it hit me: why not actually reward the player for hoarding like this? Anyhow, there goes another weekend.

FAQ

Is it mid-save compatible?

Yes. Hall of Triumph, Isa, and the Shattered Ring are designed to initialize when an existing campaign is loaded. As always with a major mod update, keeping a backup save is recommended.

Does it require a new game?

No. If Penelope's Star exists in your sector, the Shattered Ring will be generated the next time the campaign is loaded. Random-sector setups without Penelope's Star safely skip its generation.

Does it require any other mods?

No. All integrations are optional and are only activated when their corresponding mods are installed.

How do I meet Isa?

Build a functional Hall of Triumph, then look for her in a dockside bar event.

Known incompatibilities?

Second-in-Command may make Humanity less useful because of the way it changes or removes Neural Link behavior. I have not found any hard startup incompatibilities, but please report anything strange on GitHub or in this thread.

If yer really scared, avoid IndEvo or Terraforming or anything else that touches the planets in general

Does it work in randomized sectors?

The Hall of Triumph and Isa's showcase programs do. However, A Borrowed Name currently requires the vanilla Penelope's Star system and cannot begin in randomized sectors that omit it.

Hints and Progression Spoilers

SpoilerShips must be placed inside a Hall of Triumph's dedicated storage tab to count toward network generation and Isa's showcase programs.

Most doctrine hullmods require 40 unique deployment points from that faction or subtype. Domain Derelict/Explorarium ships require 20 unique deployment points.

The vanilla doctrine programs cover XIV Battlegroup, Luddic Path, Lion's Guard, Tri-Tachyon/high-tech, Remnant, and Domain Derelict ships.

To complete Awe, display an Onslaught XIV, Paragon, Invictus, Conquest, and Executor.

Display the Ziggurat and an Onslaught Mk.I to complete two unique-ship trophy programs.

SpoilerComplete every vanilla doctrine and vanilla unique-ship program to recruit Isa as a level-8 officer with two exclusive skills.

After recruiting Isa, bring her to the Shattered Ring in Penelope's Star to begin A Borrowed Name.

SpoilerThe quest eventually requires investigating both surviving Coronal Hypershunts. Compare what you recover from them carefully, and make sure you have Transverse Jump.
